layout.heading: Get involved with ComSoc.
layout.text: Join the team, pitch an event or volunteer at the next one. Every chapter committee is built by students like you.

name: IEEE Communications Society
tagline: To advance communications and networking technology for the betterment of humanity.
about:
With the collective goal “to advance communications and networking technology for the betterment of humanity”, the IEEE Communications Society connects young engineers with a global community of professionals in communication technology across more than 140 countries — engineers, academics, practitioners, scientists and executives developing higher industry standards and changing the way we all communicate.

As a student branch chapter we organise distinguished lectures, informative talks and hands-on events — from capturing live images from NOAA weather satellites to radio fox hunts across the faculty.
